name: NatSec100 2023
description: Inaugural ranked list of top 100 VC-backed defense/dual-use startups. Momentum methodology (headcount growth, total capital, fundraising momentum). Requires evidence of national-security customers. Public validation surface.

name: NatSec100 2024
description: Second edition; aperture widened beyond narrow defense categories to national-security-adjacent sectors (homeland security, intelligence, financial crimes). 44 new companies vs 2023. Public validation surface.

name: NatSec100 2025
description: Third edition; same momentum methodology plus FOCI vetting; NOT procurement-gated (treated as public national-security validation). Roster table image-rendered in official PDF; full extraction failed.

name: NatSec100 2026
description: Fourth edition; Pryzm USG contracting data as direct ranking input; eligibility gate of >=1 U.S. government contract by Dec 31 2025 plus FOCI review. Treated as procurement-gated conversion surface (2026 only).
